def: Total dollars spent divided by the number of rewrites accepted so far.
The share of outer-loop steps whose candidate passes the gate.
A pattern in which each further improvement costs more than the last because good edits become scarcer or smaller.
The rate at which direct improvement productivity falls as capability rises, written sigma in Burtsev's model.
Burtsev's R_AI: the realised feedback gain divided by frontier hardness, where above 1 improvements compound and below 1 they fade.
The share of a capability gain that passes through evaluation, integration and deployment into successor systems.
The strength of the feedback from AI capability to later research productivity when downstream use is unconstrained.
The percentage change in an output for a one percent change in an input.
The multiplier around a feedback loop; gains compound when it exceeds 1 and fade when it is below 1.
